verses.original: וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח נְחֹ֔שֶׁת עֶשְׂרִ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔וֹ וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה רָחְבּ֑וֹ וְעֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת קוֹמָתֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś miz·baḥ nə·ḥō·šeṯ ‘eś·rîm ’am·māh ’ā·rə·kōw wə·‘eś·rîm ’am·māh rā·ḥə·bōw wə·‘e·śer ’am·mō·wṯ qō·w·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: He made a bronze altar twenty cubits long twenty cubits wide and ten cubits high
verses.literalPt: TAMBÉM fez um altar de metal, de vinte côvados de comprimento, de vinte côvados de largura e de dez côvados de altura.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־ הַיָּ֖ם מוּצָ֑ק עֶ֣שֶׂר בָּֽ֠אַמָּה מִשְּׂפָת֨וֹ אֶל־ שְׂפָת֜וֹ עָג֣וֹל׀ סָבִ֗יב וְחָמֵ֤שׁ בָּֽאַמָּה֙ קֽוֹמָת֔וֹ וְקָו֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֥ב אֹת֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’eṯ- hay·yām mū·ṣāq ‘e·śer bā·’am·māh miś·śə·p̄ā·ṯōw ’el- śə·p̄ā·ṯōw ‘ā·ḡō·wl sā·ḇîḇ wə·ḥā·mêš bā·’am·māh qō·w·mā·ṯōw wə·qāw šə·lō·šîm bā·’am·māh yā·sōḇ ’ō·ṯōw sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: He also made the Sea of cast metal It was circular in shape . . . measuring ten cubits from rim to rim five cubits in height and thirty cubits in circumference . . .
verses.literalPt: Fez também o mar de fundição, de dez côvados de uma borda até a outra, redondo, e de cinco côvados de altura; cingia-o ao redor um cordão de trinta côvados.

verses.original: וּדְמ֣וּת בְּקָרִים֩ תַּ֨חַת ל֜וֹ סָבִ֤יב׀ סָבִיב֙ סוֹבְבִ֣ים אֹת֔וֹ עֶ֚שֶׂר בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה מַקִּיפִ֥ים אֶת־ הַיָּ֖ם סָבִ֑יב שְׁנַ֤יִם טוּרִים֙ הַבָּקָ֔ר יְצוּקִ֖ים בְּמֻֽצַקְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḏə·mūṯ bə·qā·rîm ta·ḥaṯ lōw sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ sō·wḇ·ḇîm ’ō·ṯōw ‘e·śer bā·’am·māh maq·qî·p̄îm ’eṯ- hay·yām sā·ḇîḇ šə·na·yim ṭū·rîm hab·bā·qār yə·ṣū·qîm bə·mu·ṣaq·tōw
verses.literal: Below the rim figures of oxen encircled . . . . . . it ten per cubit all the way around the Sea cast in two rows as a part of the Sea
verses.literalPt: E por baixo dele havia figuras de bois, que cingiam o mar ao redor, dez em cada côvado, contornando-o; e tinha duas fileiras de bois, fundidos juntamente com o mar.

verses.original: עוֹמֵ֞ד עַל־ שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֗ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה פֹנִ֣ים׀ צָפ֡וֹנָה וּשְׁלוֹשָׁה֩ פֹנִ֨ים׀ יָ֜מָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה׀ פֹּנִ֣ים נֶ֗גְבָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פֹּנִ֣ים מִזְרָ֔חָה וְהַיָּ֥ם עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְכָל־ אֲחֹרֵיהֶ֖ם בָּֽיְתָה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·w·mêḏ ‘al- šə·nêm ‘ā·śār bā·qār šə·lō·šāh p̄ō·nîm ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh ū·šə·lō·wō·šāh p̄ō·nîm yām·māh ū·šə·lō·šāh pō·nîm neḡ·bāh ū·šə·lō·šāh pō·nîm miz·rā·ḥāh wə·hay·yām ‘ă·lê·hem mil·mā·‘ə·lāh wə·ḵāl ’ă·ḥō·rê·hem bā·yə·ṯāh
verses.literal: The Sea stood on twelve . . . oxen three facing north three facing west three facing south and three facing east The Sea rested on them . . . with all their hindquarters toward the center
verses.literalPt: E o mar estava posto sobre doze bois; três que olhavam para o norte, três que olhavam para o ocidente, três que olhavam para o sul e três que olhavam para o oriente; e o mar estava posto sobre eles; e as suas partes posteriores estavam todas para o lado de dentro.

verses.original: וְעָבְי֣וֹ טֶ֔פַח וּשְׂפָתוֹ֙ כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שְׂפַת־ כּ֔וֹס פֶּ֖רַח שֽׁוֹשַׁנָּ֑ה מַחֲזִ֣יק בַּתִּ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים יָכִֽיל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḇə·yōw ṭe·p̄aḥ ū·śə·p̄ā·ṯōw kə·ma·‘ă·śêh śə·p̄aṯ- kō·ws pe·raḥ šō·wō·šan·nāh ma·ḥă·zîq bat·tîm šə·lō·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm yā·ḵîl
verses.literal: It was a handbreadth thick and its rim was fashioned like the brim of a cup like a lily . . . blossom It could hold three thousand baths
verses.literalPt: E tinha um palmo de grossura, e a sua borda foi feita como a borda de um copo, ou como uma flor-de-lis, da capacidade de três mil batos.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ כִּיּוֹרִים֮ עֲשָׂרָה֒ וַ֠יִּתֵּן חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה מִיָּמִ֜ין וַחֲמִשָּׁ֤ה מִשְּׂמֹאול֙ לְרָחְצָ֣ה בָהֶ֔ם אֶת־ מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הָעוֹלָ֖ה יָדִ֣יחוּ בָ֑ם וְהַיָּ֕ם לְרָחְצָ֥ה לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś kî·yō·w·rîm ‘ă·śā·rāh way·yit·tên ḥă·miš·šāh mî·yā·mîn wa·ḥă·miš·šāh miś·śə·mō·wl lə·rā·ḥə·ṣāh ḇā·hem ’eṯ- ma·‘ă·śêh hā·‘ō·w·lāh yā·ḏî·ḥū ḇām wə·hay·yām lə·rā·ḥə·ṣāh lak·kō·hă·nîm bōw
verses.literal: He also made ten basins for washing and placed five on the south side and five on the north The parts of the burnt offering were rinsed in them but the priests used the Sea for washing
verses.literalPt: Também fez dez pias; e pôs cinco à direita e cinco à esquerda, para lavarem nelas; o que pertencia ao holocausto o lavavam nelas; porém o mar era para que os sacerdotes se lavassem nele.

verses.original: וַ֠יַּעַשׂ אֶת־ מְנֹר֧וֹת הַזָּהָ֛ב עֶ֖שֶׂר כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֑ם וַיִּתֵּן֙ בַּֽהֵיכָ֔ל חָמֵ֥שׁ מִיָּמִ֖ין וְחָמֵ֥שׁ מִשְּׂמֹֽאול׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’eṯ- mə·nō·rō·wṯ haz·zā·hāḇ ‘e·śer kə·miš·pā·ṭām way·yit·tên ba·hê·ḵāl ḥā·mêš mî·yā·mîn wə·ḥā·mêš miś·śə·mō·wl
verses.literal: He made ten gold lampstands according to their specifications and placed them in the temple five on the south side and five on the north
verses.literalPt: Fez também dez castiçais de ouro, segundo a sua forma, e pô-los no templo, cinco à direita, e cinco à esquerda.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שֻׁלְחָנוֹת֮ עֲשָׂרָה֒ וַיַּנַּח֙ בַּֽהֵיכָ֔ל חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה מִיָּמִ֖ין וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה מִשְּׂמֹ֑אול וַיַּ֛עַשׂ מִזְרְקֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב מֵאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś šul·ḥā·nō·wṯ ‘ă·śā·rāh way·yan·naḥ ba·hê·ḵāl ḥă·miš·šāh mî·yā·mîn wa·ḥă·miš·šāh miś·śə·mō·wl way·ya·‘aś miz·rə·qê zā·hāḇ mê·’āh
verses.literal: Additionally, he made ten tables and placed them in the temple five on the south side and five on the north He also made a hundred gold bowls
verses.literalPt: Também fez dez mesas, e pô-las no templo, cinco à direita e cinco à esquerda; também fez cem bacias de ouro.

verses.original: וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ חֲצַ֣ר הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים וְהָעֲזָרָ֖ה הַגְּדוֹלָ֑ה וּדְלָת֧וֹת לָעֲזָרָ֛ה וְדַלְתוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם צִפָּ֥ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ḥă·ṣar hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hā·‘ă·zā·rāh hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh ū·ḏə·lā·ṯō·wṯ lā·‘ă·zā·rāh wə·ḏal·ṯō·w·ṯê·hem ṣip·pāh nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: He made the courtyard of the priests and the large court with its doors . . . and he overlaid the doors with bronze
verses.literalPt: Fez mais o pátio dos sacerdotes, e o grande átrio; como também as portas para o pátio, as quais revestiu de cobre.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַיָּ֗ם נָתַ֞ן מִכֶּ֧תֶף הַיְמָנִ֛ית קֵ֖דְמָה מִמּ֥וּל נֶֽגְבָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hay·yām nā·ṯan mik·ke·ṯep̄ hay·mā·nîṯ qê·ḏə·māh mim·mūl neḡ·bāh
verses.literal: He put the Sea on the south side at the southeast corner . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E pôs o mar ao lado direito, para o lado do oriente, na direção do sul.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ חוּרָ֔ם אֶת־ הַ֨סִּיר֔וֹת וְאֶת־ הַיָּעִ֖ים וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְרָק֑וֹתס וַיְכַ֣ל חִירָם לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־ הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בְּבֵ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ḥū·rām ’eṯ- has·sî·rō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- hay·yā·‘îm wə·’eṯ- ham·miz·rå̄·qō·ṯs way·ḵal ḥī·rå̄m la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- ham·mə·lā·ḵāh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lam·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh bə·ḇêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Additionally, Huram made the pots shovels and sprinkling bowls So Huram finished the work that he had undertaken for King Solomon in the house of God
verses.literalPt: Também Hirão fez as caldeiras, as pás e as bacias. Assim acabou Hirão de fazer a obra, que fazia para o rei Salomão, na casa de Deus.

verses.original: עַמּוּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם וְהַגֻּלּ֧וֹת וְהַכֹּתָר֛וֹת עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִ֖ים שְׁתָּ֑יִם וְהַשְּׂבָכ֣וֹת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְכַסּ֗וֹת אֶת־ שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלּ֣וֹת הַכֹּֽתָר֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הָֽעַמּוּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mū·ḏîm šə·na·yim wə·hag·gul·lō·wṯ wə·hak·kō·ṯā·rō·wṯ ‘al- rōš hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm šə·tā·yim wə·haś·śə·ḇā·ḵō·wṯ šə·ta·yim lə·ḵas·sō·wṯ ’eṯ- šə·tê gul·lō·wṯ hak·kō·ṯā·rō·wṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- rōš hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm
verses.literal: the two pillars the two bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars the two sets of network covering both bowls of the capitals - atop the pillars
verses.literalPt: As duas colunas, os globos, e os dois capitéis sobre as cabeças das colunas; e as duas redes, para cobrir os dois globos dos capitéis, que estavam sobre a cabeça das colunas.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הָֽרִמּוֹנִ֛ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת לִשְׁתֵּ֣י הַשְּׂבָכ֑וֹת שְׁנַ֨יִם טוּרִ֤ים רִמּוֹנִים֙ לַשְּׂבָכָ֣ה הָאֶחָ֔ת לְכַסּ֗וֹת אֶת־ שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלּ֣וֹת הַכֹּֽתָר֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hā·rim·mō·w·nîm ’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ liš·tê haś·śə·ḇā·ḵō·wṯ šə·na·yim ṭū·rîm rim·mō·w·nîm laś·śə·ḇā·ḵāh hā·’e·ḥāṯ lə·ḵas·sō·wṯ ’eṯ- šə·tê gul·lō·wṯ hak·kō·ṯā·rō·wṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm
verses.literal: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network covering both the bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars)
verses.literalPt: E as quatrocentas romãs para as duas redes; duas carreiras de romãs para cada rede, para cobrirem os dois globos dos capitéis que estavam em cima das colunas.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַמְּכֹנ֖וֹת עָשָׂ֑ה וְאֶת־ הַכִּיֹּר֥וֹת עָשָׂ֖ה עַל־ הַמְּכֹנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ham·mə·ḵō·nō·wṯ ‘ā·śāh wə·’eṯ- hak·kî·yō·rō·wṯ ‘ā·śāh ‘al- ham·mə·ḵō·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: the stands the basins . . . on the stands
verses.literalPt: Também fez as bases; e as pias pôs sobre as bases;

verses.original: אֶת־ הַיָּ֖ם אֶחָ֑ד וְאֶת־ הַבָּקָ֥ר שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֖ר תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- hay·yām ’e·ḥāḏ wə·’eṯ- hab·bā·qār šə·nêm- ‘ā·śār taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: - the Sea the twelve . . . oxen underneath the Sea
verses.literalPt: Um mar, e os doze bois debaixo dele;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַ֠סִּירוֹת וְאֶת־ הַיָּעִ֤ים וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְלָגוֹת֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כְּלֵיהֶ֔ם עָשָׂ֞ה חוּרָ֥ם אָבִ֛יו לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה נְחֹ֖שֶׁת מָרֽוּק׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- has·sî·rō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- hay·yā·‘îm wə·’eṯ- ham·miz·lā·ḡō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- kāl- kə·lê·hem ‘ā·śāh ḥū·rām ’ā·ḇîw lam·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh lə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh nə·ḥō·šeṯ mā·rūq
verses.literal: and the pots shovels meat forks and all the other articles All these objects that Huram-abi . . . made for King Solomon for the house of the LORD were of polished bronze
verses.literalPt: Semelhantemente as caldeiras, as pás, os garfos e todos os seus utensílios, fez Hirão Abiú ao rei Salomão, para a casa do SENHOR, de cobre polido.

verses.original: בְּכִכַּ֤ר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ יְצָקָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ בַּעֲבִ֖י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה בֵּ֥ין סֻכּ֖וֹת וּבֵ֥ין צְרֵדָֽתָה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵik·kar hay·yar·dên yə·ṣā·qām ham·me·leḵ ba·‘ă·ḇî hā·’ă·ḏā·māh bên suk·kō·wṯ ū·ḇên ṣə·rê·ḏā·ṯāh
verses.literal: The king . . . had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Succoth . . . and Zeredah
verses.literalPt: Na campina do Jordão os fundiu o rei, na terra argilosa, entre Sucote e Zeredá.

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לָרֹ֣ב מְאֹ֑ד כִּ֛י לֹ֥א נֶחְקַ֖ר מִשְׁקַ֥ל הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś šə·lō·mōh kāl- hak·kê·lîm hā·’êl·leh lā·rōḇ mə·’ōḏ kî lō neḥ·qar miš·qal han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: Solomon made all these articles in such great abundance . . . that the weight of the bronze could not be determined
verses.literalPt: E fez Salomão todos estes objetos em grande abundância, que não se podia averiguar o peso do cobre.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָנ֔וֹת וַעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś šə·lō·mōh ’êṯ kāl- hak·kê·lîm ’ă·šer bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·’êṯ miz·baḥ haz·zā·hāḇ wə·’eṯ- haš·šul·ḥā·nō·wṯ wa·‘ă·lê·hem le·ḥem hap·pā·nîm
verses.literal: Solomon also made all the furnishings for the house of God the golden altar the tables on which was placed the Bread of the Presence
verses.literalPt: Fez também Salomão todos os objetos que eram para a casa de Deus, como também o altar de ouro, e as mesas, sobre as quais estavam os pães da proposição.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַמְּנֹר֞וֹת וְנֵרֹתֵיהֶ֗ם לְבַעֲרָ֧ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֛ט לִפְנֵ֥י הַדְּבִ֖יר זָהָ֥ב סָגֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ham·mə·nō·rō·wṯ wə·nê·rō·ṯê·hem lə·ḇa·‘ă·rām kam·miš·pāṭ lip̄·nê had·də·ḇîr zā·hāḇ sā·ḡūr
verses.literal: the lampstands of pure gold and their lamps to burn in front of the inner sanctuary as prescribed
verses.literalPt: E os castiçais com as suas lâmpadas de ouro finíssimo, para as acenderem segundo o costume, perante o oráculo.

verses.original: וְהַפֶּ֧רַח וְהַנֵּר֛וֹת וְהַמֶּלְקַחַ֖יִם זָהָ֑ב ה֖וּא מִכְל֥וֹת זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hap·pe·raḥ wə·han·nê·rō·wṯ wə·ham·mel·qa·ḥa·yim zā·hāḇ hū miḵ·lō·wṯ zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: the flowers lamps . . . and tongs of gold of purest gold
verses.literalPt: E as flores, as lâmpadas e os espevitadores eram de ouro, do mais finíssimo ouro.

verses.original: וְהַֽמְזַמְּר֧וֹת וְהַמִּזְרָק֛וֹת וְהַכַּפּ֥וֹת וְהַמַּחְתּ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וּפֶ֣תַח הַ֠בַּיִת דַּלְתוֹתָ֨יו הַפְּנִימִיּ֜וֹת לְקֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים וְדַלְתֵ֥י הַבַּ֛יִת לַהֵיכָ֖ל זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·zam·mə·rō·wṯ wə·ham·miz·rā·qō·wṯ wə·hak·kap·pō·wṯ wə·ham·maḥ·tō·wṯ zā·hāḇ sā·ḡūr ū·p̄e·ṯaḥ hab·ba·yiṯ dal·ṯō·w·ṯāw hap·pə·nî·mî·yō·wṯ lə·qō·ḏeš haq·qo·ḏā·šîm wə·ḏal·ṯê hab·ba·yiṯ la·hê·ḵāl zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: the wick trimmers sprinkling bowls ladles and censers of pure gold and the gold doors of the temple the inner doors to the Most Holy Place . . . as well as the doors of the main hall
verses.literalPt: Como também os apagadores, as bacias, as colheres e os incensários de ouro finíssimo; e quanto à entrada da casa, as suas portas de dentro do lugar santíssimo, e as portas da casa do templo, eram de ouro.
